description.value: Duffin Cove Resort is a private oceanfront property in Tofino offering studios, waterfront cabins perched at the edge of a private cove (accessed via 50 stairs), and a full condo suite — all set against ancient rainforest and the rugged Clayoquot Sound shoreline. Operated under The MAQ Hotel group, it sits just steps from central Tofino while feeling distinctly removed from the bustle. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a genuine west coast retreat with free parking, though the cliff-and-staircase geography of the cabins would make loaded bike handling logistically demanding.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and active, with recent blog posts dated late 2025, confirming the business is open. The website lists 'Fast, complimentary Wi-Fi' and cabin/condo pages confirm 'Free unlimited wifi access,' providing clear evidence for that amenity. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, or cycling-specific services appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null per the evidence rules. The website confirms the OSM address (215 Campbell St, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0) and provides phone numbers absent from the OSM record.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists Toll Free 1.866.425.3448 and Local 250.725.3448 — the local number has been added to the top-level phone field.
Cabins are accessed by 50 stairs into a private cove, which may make handling loaded touring bikes or trailers very difficult — worth noting for cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating oceanfront resort in Tofino with a current website, recent blog activity, and bookings available — a legitimate accommodation stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: private oceanfront property... ancient rainforest and the rugged Clayoquot Sound shoreline
